model_annotation: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for multiple model/configuration variants, shown as several colored loss trajectories with matching semi-transparent bands around each line. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 140,000 iterations with tick marks at regular 20,000-iteration intervals (0, 20k, 40k, …, 140k). The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from about 2.4 to 3.4 with closely spaced tick labels that appear at 0.1-loss increments (2.4, 2.5, …, 3.4). The “Vanilla” curve is a purple solid line with no markers that starts near roughly 3.3–3.4 loss at the left edge and declines to around the low 2.3s by ~140k iterations, with a steep early drop followed by a slower downward trend. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” curve is a light/medium blue solid line without markers that begins near ~3.3–3.4 and decreases to a higher endpoint than most others, ending around the mid‑2.4s by ~140k, also showing a pronounced early decline and then a gradual decrease. The “SepLLM (n=64)” variants are shown as multiple solid lines without markers in orange and green (and additional SepLLM-labeled entries in the legend), each starting around ~3.3–3.4 and decreasing across the full iteration range, reaching endpoints clustered around the low-to-mid 2.3s near ~140k; their shapes similarly show a sharper reduction early (around the first ~20k iterations) and a flatter decline thereafter. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” curve is a red solid line without markers that follows the same overall downward pattern from ~3.3–3.4 at the start to roughly the low 2.3s at the end. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” curve is a darker blue solid line without markers, also decreasing from ~3.3–3.4 initially to around the low 2.3s by ~140k. The “SepLLM (n=128)” entry appears as an additional solid line (with a corresponding legend entry) that tracks the same general decreasing trajectory over iterations, starting near ~3.3–3.4 and ending near the low-to-mid 2.3s, with a semi-transparent band surrounding it like the other series.
